inputs.name: sourceRoot
inputs.description: Repository-relative root of Japanese Markdown source files.

inputs.name: outputRoot
inputs.description: Repository-relative root for mirrored v2 Vietnamese Markdown and cache files.

inputs.name: glossary
inputs.description: Project terminology and translation rules read by the miss-only model step.

inputs.name: exclude
inputs.description: Exclude globs are repository-relative source document patterns omitted from translation, cache checks and repair; they must not start with !.

inputs.name: syncBase
inputs.description: Branch receiving the source sync and generated translation pull requests.

inputs.name: sourceBranch
inputs.description: Head branch whose merged pull request into syncBase starts translation.

inputs.name: gateBases
inputs.description: Pull request bases on which every v2 cache must match its reviewed translation.

inputs.name: branchPrefix
inputs.description: Prefix for generated translation branches, normally bwv/translation.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Model used only for v2 cache misses.

inputs.name: maxFilesPerGroup
inputs.description: Maximum source files in a group and maximum concurrent translations for that group.

inputs.name: timeoutMinutes
inputs.description: Time limit in minutes for each miss-only model process.

inputs.name: maxTurns
inputs.description: Maximum turns for each miss-only model process.

inputs.name: maxBudgetUsd
inputs.description: Runaway cost guard for each miss-only model process.

inputs.name: maxRepairs
inputs.description: Same-session repairs allowed after the read-only result validator rejects output.

inputs.name: toolkit
inputs.description: Complete replacement for the trusted v2 scripts and miss-only translation skill.
